screen_policy: Every slide must prove the exact copy through visible Aachu/Zuv behavior. Any doubtful slide blocks image generation until repaired and re-reviewed.

slide_reviews.copy:
This is the kind of love
I want us to grow into.

The date began with one missing key
and two suspects.

By the third wrong turn,
nobody was cute anymore.

“Don’t talk to me.”

He gave her the minute.
Not the distance.

It wasn’t really the wrong turn.

They had simply missed each other
for too many ordinary days.

The plan failed.
The date didn’t.

He still checked the lock twice.
She still rolled her eyes.

Then she went back
and checked it with him.

director_storyboard.physical_event: A scooter date is delayed by a missing key and difficult road access, briefly strains, then becomes an improvised roadside chai date before a comic home callback.

director_storyboard.relationship_change: They move from childish blame and split attention into a respected pause, renewed closeness, and a shared joke about the habits that still irritate them.
director_storyboard.sequence_read: A forward teaser offers chai, a flashback shows how the date went wrong, body distance peaks at the pause, and object transfer plus the home callback release the tension.
